Title: Beheading of John the Baptist
DateApprox: c. AD 27-30 or AD 30-33 (approx., date debated)
KeyPersons: John the Baptist; Herod Antipas; Herodias
Events: Herod Antipas, bound by a rash oath at a birthday feast and pressed by Herodias, orders John the Baptist beheaded in prison, and John's disciples bury his body.
